name: copy-trading-platform
description: Copy trading platform: broker-agnostic copy engine with Zerodha Kite Connect and Angel One SmartAPI adapters.

scripts.build:packages: npm run generate -w @ctp/database && tsc -b packages/types packages/config packages/shared packages/database
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n pkg,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm:dev:packages" "npm run dev -w @ctp/api" "npm run dev -w @ctp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ctp/api && npm run build -w @ctp/worker && npm run build -w @ctp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @ctp/api -w @ctp/worker -w @ctp/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo apps/api/dist apps/worker/dist apps/web/.next
